title: C¹ regularity of the tangential coefficient field G⁻¹A*u
statement: For all n, N ∈ ℕ, every open V ⊆ ℝⁿ, every ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ that is C² on V with fderiv ℝ ψ x injective for all x ∈ V, and every u : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ that is C¹ on V: the tangential coefficient field a(x) := G(x)⁻¹(A(x)* u(x)), where A(x) := fderiv ℝ ψ x, A(x)* := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A(x) and G(x)⁻¹ := Ring.inverse (A(x)* ∘ A(x)), is C¹ on V.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (u : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V → (∀ x ∈ V, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ x)) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x ↦ Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) (u x))) V
